title: Briefing for 2026-11-21
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-21: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices. Record diesel prices drive UK inflation to 1-year high of 3.6%. St. Louis Fed's Musalem says four more rate hikes may be needed in coming months. Peterson: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means. Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite. AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds.
global: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide. Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk. Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations. Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge. Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032. Faisal Islam: This cost-cutting UK-EU deal doesn't mean lower prices will follow.
philippines: All about MUNI, a platform turning online conversations into real-world action. Watching alone wasn’t enough, so these Filipino YouTube fans found each other offline. Animator Clister Santos makes peace with his absent mother in 3D short. Can you afford to study in Europe? A Filipino’s guide to scholarships, costs.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
